AUDIT WARN EXPLAINED (row-count anomaly, Q19 vs median 152): NOT a defect and not conflation. 'Don't know' was an offered response that data/carver_2017_puggs_items.py drops, so per-item n is effectively a non-response measure and varies with item difficulty. Q19 is one of the five stems containing the word 'epigenetic', and those five are exactly the five lowest-n items (86, 104, 105, 110, 114, then a gap to 128) -- which is the same fact this table's Step 5b evidence uses to prove the data follow Code Book numbering. A property of the response data, not of the item text.

AUDIT WARN EXPLAINED, two parts, neither a defect. (1) Row-count anomaly at Q15: 'don't know' is dropped rather than scored, so per-item n varies 35-70 of 78 with difficulty, and Q15 is one of the five 'epigenetic' stems that are exactly the five lowest-n items -- the paper itself reports epigenetics items drew the most don't-knows. (2) 100% blank option_text is BY DESIGN: resp is a dichotomous correctness score (the script recodes True/False against the published key to 1/0), not a chosen option, so there are no option labels to transcribe and padding them would invent content.

AUDIT WARN EXPLAINED (3 of 23 items have no option_text rows, and carry live resp values without one). Correct behaviour in all three cases. M022043's five alternatives are PICTURES of shaded circles -- there is no option wording to transcribe and none was invented. M022232 and M022234B are constructed-response items with no alternatives at all; TIMSS documentation gives only 'See scoring guide', so correct_response is blank rather than guessed. The live resp values (0/1) are a dichotomous SCORE for these items, not an option choice, which is why they exist without option rows. Blank-when-uncertain is the standard's required behaviour here.

AUDIT WARN EXPLAINED (row-count anomaly across 25 items, median 344): this is the TIMSS BOOKLET DESIGN, not missingness skew or conflation. The 14 block-M04 items were answered only in booklet 4 (n=344 each); the 11 block-M05 items in booklets 4 and 5 (n=698 each). That two-level split is predicted by the released-items PDF's own Block column and reproduces 25/25, and it is used as corroborating evidence in this table's Step 5b row. A property of the assessment design.
